title: Stop Comparing Your Chapter 1 to Their Chapter 20 💭 | Run Your Own Race
description:
You scroll and see someone your age — already there. The car. The house. The perfect life.

But you didn't see the nights they almost quit. And they didn't see what you've survived.

Comparison is a race where everyone runs a different track. The only person you need to beat is yesterday's you.

Slow progress is still progress.

🔔 Subscribe if you sometimes need a push forward.

#motivation #comparison #mindset #selfworth #selfimprovement #motivationalvideo #personalgrowth #progress
